publish.card_hook: A free Juneteenth festival returns to Raymond James Stadium in Tampa with live entertainment, an art district and food vendors.
publish.verify_note: 2026-09-22: roctheblockinc.com homepage states June 17 to 19, 2027, Tampa FL, at Raymond James Stadium, free for the community; organizer's dates differ slightly from the lead (2027-06-16 to 06-19), organizer's own dates used.

publish.card_hook: Downtown Monticello celebrates its annual Watermelon Festival with a parade, live entertainment and local vendors around the courthouse.
publish.verify_note: 2026-09-22: monticellowatermelonfestival.com homepage states 2027 Watermelon Festival, June 18 + 19, 2027, matching lead dates; site gives no single street address so downtown Monticello courthouse coordinates used.

publish.card_hook: Free Juneteenth celebration at Cocoa Riverfront Park with live performances, art, food and vendors.
